question: Which tool should the H key pick: the Hand or Highlight?
context: The Hand is built: it sits at the end of the tool bar after Measure, as the UI design mock draws it, and a drag with it moves the view without moving anything. Your mocks and Photoshop print it as Hand (H), but H has been Highlight in Photonz since the first picture tool bar. Until you pick, the Hand ships with no key.

options.label: H picks the Hand, Highlight moves to U
options.summary: Press H anywhere in Photonz Next and the Hand comes up, the way it does in Photoshop and in every tool bar in your mocks. Highlight answers to U instead, and its tooltip and Edit > Tools row say U.
pros: Same key as Photoshop and as the 79 tool bars in your mocks that print Hand (H)
Matches your rule: on a clash, Photoshop keeps the key and the other tool moves
cons: Anyone in Next who presses H for Highlight now gets the Hand
options.mitigation: Highlight tooltip and menu row show U right away, and the release Photonz stays on H for Highlight.

options.label: H stays Highlight, the Hand has no key
options.summary: Nothing changes from how it ships today: H is still Highlight, and you pick the Hand by clicking it at the end of the tool bar, under More, or in Edit > Tools.
pros: No key anyone already knows changes
cons: A Photoshop user who presses H gets a highlighter, not the Hand
The Hand is the one tool on the bar with no key
options.mitigation: The Hand is always the last button on the bar, so it is easy to find with the pointer.

options.label: H picks the Hand only in Design
options.summary: In the Design mode H brings up the Hand. In every other mode H is still Highlight.
pros: Design gets the Photoshop key and picture work keeps its key
cons: One key does two things depending on the mode, so people stop trusting it
In Design, Highlight under More loses its key
options.mitigation: The tooltip always prints the key that works in the current mode.

options.label: No Hand tool
options.summary: Take the Hand off the tool bar. To move around a zoomed picture you scroll with two fingers on the trackpad, as you do today.
pros: One fewer button on the bar
cons: The Design bar no longer matches your mock, which ends with the Hand
No way to pan with a mouse
options.mitigation: Two finger scrolling keeps working everywhere.
